import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between price and megapixels
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                          size='weight_grams', sizes=(20, 300), alpha=0.7, palette='deep')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
